description: Desired branch protection for financial-analysis. Apply with: pnpm run sync:branch-protection
notes: required_approving_review_count is 0 for solo-maintainer flow (GitHub never allows self-approval).
All checks run on every PR. Doc-only and workers-only PRs skip heavy steps but still report success.
E2E smoke runs Playwright when web paths change; CodeQL runs when non-doc code changes; MCP policy runs focused authorization checks when MCP/OAuth paths change.
Push to main/dev with doc-only paths still skips ci.yml via paths-ignore on push.
